cells: 5 families x 2 variants x 3 instruments (GOLD, SILVER, WTI) x 1 timeframe (1h) = 30 fixed cells. Judgement unit = one instrument (per-instrument verdicts, per the tasking: XAUUSD first, then XAGUSD, WTI).

common_conventions.atr: Wilder ATR(14) via rd/common.atr, taken at the signal bar (fastsim convention).
common_conventions.costs: rd2/costs2.py OANDA-practice model, round trip: GOLD 10 bps, SILVER 14 bps, WTI 12 bps, applied adversely in price space per side by the harness simulator.
common_conventions.counting: One (config, instrument, timeframe) cell = one trial; one wf-select procedure per (family, instrument) = one trial. All RD-007 trials join the same global counter and the same final-N Bonferroni gate as RD-001/RD-002/RD-003.
common_conventions.intraday_containment: Every position is flat by 21:00 UTC on its entry date. Implemented exactly: each entry is simulated on the slice of bars from its signal bar through the last bar starting before 21:00 UTC that date, with bracket_time max_bars spanning the slice — a position cannot cross a session end, a weekend, or a data gap by construction. An entry is only taken when the entry bar is on the same UTC date as its signal bar and starts <= 2h after the signal bar (contiguity rule).
common_conventions.simulation: Harness MODULE convention via rd/fastsim.simulate_entries (signal on close of bar i -> entry at open of bar i+1; entry bar exit-checked; gap-through fills at the open; stop before target inside a bar; one position at a time). Bracket levels anchored to the ENTRY price (the fastsim declared convention).

data.gaps: Exchange closures (weekends/holidays) are genuine absences in the series, audited in the RD-002 sidecars, never interpolated. Intraday containment (below) makes weekend/holiday gaps structurally unable to hold a position.

No variant, threshold, session window, cell or exit spec below may be altered after that PR is opened; any change requires a new declaration and a restarted trial count for the affected cells.

families.differentiation: No judged family uses a New York opening range. RD-003's london_drive (pooled forex12/comm7) uses the Asia range and a 07:00 UTC break; RD-002's session_breakout is a crypto pattern family. This family is per-instrument, NY-anchored, metals/energy only.
families.mechanism: New York opening-range breakout: the 13:00-14:59 UTC range (the COMEX/NY liquidity open for metals and energy) sets the day's reference; the first close beyond it during 15:00-18:00 UTC rides the session's primary directional move.
families.name: orb_breakout

signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 1.5 / tp 3.0 ATR, flat 21:00 UTC
signal_rules.filter_narrow: orb_narrow additionally requires range width <= 1.5 x ATR(14) at the signal bar
signal_rules.range: high/low of the bars starting 13:00 and 14:00 UTC of the same date; both bars must be present, else no trade that day
signal_rules.signal: first bar with start hour in {15,16,17,18} whose close > range high -> LONG; close < range low -> SHORT; at most one signal per day

families.differentiation: RD-002's donchian/turtle families hold multi-day positions on daily/4h panels; no judged family breaks the prior day's range with a same-day flat. The intraday containment is the claim.
families.mechanism: Prior-trading-day high/low breakout traded intraday: yesterday's extremes are the market's reference levels; a close through them during London/NY hours, flattened by 21:00 UTC, harvests the intraday continuation leg without overnight exposure.
families.name: prevday_breakout

signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 2.0 / tp 3.0 ATR, flat 21:00 UTC
signal_rules.filter_ema: pd_ema additionally requires close > EMA200 for LONG / close < EMA200 for SHORT at the signal bar
signal_rules.levels: high/low of the previous trading date present in the series (latest date before today with >= 12 bars)
signal_rules.signal: first bar with start hour in {8..18} whose close > prior-day high -> LONG; close < prior-day low -> SHORT; at most one signal per day

families.differentiation: RD-002's zscore/bb reversion families operate on daily/4h closes against rolling means, not on an intraday session VWAP anchor, and none is judged per-instrument on metals at 1h with same-day flat.
families.mechanism: Session-VWAP stretch fade: intraday price stretched k x ATR from the day's volume-weighted mean is faded back toward the mean; metals/energy intraday flow is dominated by benchmark/VWAP execution, which is the mechanism claimed.
families.name: vwap_reversion

signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 1.5 / tp 1.5 ATR, flat 21:00 UTC
signal_rules.signal: bar start hour in {9..18}: deviation d = (close - VWAP)/ATR(14); d >= k -> SHORT; d <= -k -> LONG
signal_rules.vwap: anchored 00:00 UTC each date; cumulative typical price x volume / cumulative volume over that date's bars up to and including the signal bar; zero-volume bars contribute nothing; if cumulative volume is 0, no signal

families.differentiation: RD-001/RD-002 judged bollinger_rsi_reversion as a discovery MODULE on daily cells (pooled panels, module-native exits); this family is a declared research configuration — fixed band/RSI thresholds, ATR bracket + session-flat exits, per-instrument metals/energy 1h judgement. The module's deleted-or-surviving production code is not touched or reused.
families.mechanism: Bollinger-band + RSI extreme fade at 1h: a close outside the 20-bar 2-sigma band with RSI(14) beyond 70/30 marks intraday exhaustion in range conditions; the fade targets the mean with a hard ATR stop.
families.name: bb_rsi_reversion

signal_rules.bands: SMA(20) +/- 2.0 x rolling std(20, ddof=1) of closes; RSI(14) Wilder via rd/common.rsi
signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 1.5 / tp 2.0 ATR, flat 21:00 UTC
signal_rules.filter_adx: bbr_adx additionally requires ADX(14) < 25 at the signal bar (range-regime filter)
signal_rules.signal: bar start hour in {8..18}: close > upper band AND RSI >= 70 -> SHORT; close < lower band AND RSI <= 30 -> LONG

families.differentiation: RD-002's donchian cells are daily/4h multi-day holds on pooled panels without session restriction or same-day flat; the judged crypto 1h trend cells are different instruments and mechanisms (momentum crosses).
families.mechanism: Intraday Donchian(20) channel breakout restricted to London/NY hours with same-day flat: at 1h, a close beyond the prior 20-bar channel during liquid hours continues intraday far more often than the same break in thin hours — the session filter is part of the claim.
families.name: donchian_intra

signal_rules.channel: max high / min low of the 20 bars strictly before the signal bar
signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 2.0 / tp 4.0 ATR, flat 21:00 UTC
signal_rules.filter_ema: dc_ema additionally requires close > EMA200 for LONG / close < EMA200 for SHORT at the signal bar
signal_rules.signal: bar start hour in {8..18}: close > channel high -> LONG; close < channel low -> SHORT

judgement.bar: Identical numeric core to RD-001/RD-002/RD-003, judged on pooled LATE-fold (W2-W5) OOS trades only: expectancy > 0 AND profit factor >= 1.2 AND >= 200 OOS trades AND positive folds per rd2/stats2.check_bar2 (>= ceil(0.8 x 4) = 4 positive folds among folds with trades, >= 3 folds with trades) AND holdout pass (below) AND Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05 / N_global.
judgement.holdout_single_instrument: holdout2's cross-symbol breadth is undefined for a one-symbol cell; the declared substitute, fixed here before any run: the W5 fold (2026-07-01 -> 2026-11-01, the final fold) must have expectancy > 0 on >= 30 trades. W5 is untouched by construction: variants are fixed ex ante and wf-select for W5 sees only pre-2026-07-01 data. Per-fold metrics for every cell are published so the coordinator can apply any stricter reading.
judgement.sensitivity_2x_costs: Run for every near-bar row (RD-002 definition: expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.15 AND >= 200 OOS trades) and every bar passer: the cell is re-simulated with all costs doubled. A candidate is PROMOTABLE only if at 2x costs expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.0; PF at 2x costs is printed for every such row regardless.
judgement.significance: Gate = Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05 / N_global via rd2/stats2.significance. Deflated Sharpe is REPORTED for every near-bar row but does not gate (RD-002 synthesis finding: at N ~ 1500+ with correlated heterogeneous trials the DSR dispersion input is not identified). N_global for this crew's synthesis = 1,557 (RD-001+RD-002 final) + 45 (RD-007) = 1,602, a declared LOWER bound: sibling Wave-4 crews (RD-003 completion, RD-004..RD-013) raise the true final N, and any RD-007 passer must be re-gated by the coordinator at that final N before wiring. The Bonferroni alpha at N = 2,000 is also reported for reference.
judgement.verdicts: Per config: PROMOTABLE (full bar + significance + 2x-cost pass), WATCHLIST (mechanical bar passed, significance or sensitivity failed — the RD-002 usage), or FAIL (with the failing checks named). UNCOVERED for 15m (above). No production, registry, priors or daemon changes; passers are wired by the coordinator/FWD lane only.

wf_select.procedures: One per (family, instrument) = 15 procedures. For each LATE fold, the procedure selects between the family's two variants using ONLY trades entered before the fold start: among variants with >= 30 in-sample trades, the higher in-sample expectancy wins; if exactly one variant qualifies it is selected; if neither qualifies, the variant with more in-sample trades is selected (tie -> first declared variant). The selected variant's trades inside the fold are the procedure's OOS trades for that fold.
